description.en: RTL-BenchLS evaluates LLMs on RTL design generation and reasoning, containing over 10,000 formally verified Verilog designs. Tasks include specification-to-RTL generation, round-trip reasoning, masked-content reasoning, and repository-issue reasoning. All tasks are verified via formal equivalence checking without manual testbenches.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing RTL benchmarks are small and saturate with frontier models. RTL-BenchLS provides a large-scale, challenging benchmark with self-supervised tasks, enabling tracking of progress on complex hardware design reasoning and generation.
